semantics: Eight early PC slots are a deliberately additional SkillPilot introduction; the five complete task competencies do not become official state J9 requirements.
Existing ordinary early module references receive only an honest display label, preserving their goal keys, target members and authored parent paths in the seven non-ST jurisdictions.

The old broad J9 exam reference would reactivate 8539 at a second parent after its reviewed selection. Only that exact reference is split; 8539 alone is omitted, all13 siblings and their effective R remain unchanged. Its canonical focus alias f6c9c2b8 is absent and requires explicit re-selection under the existing invalid-focus contract, never silent scope widening.

ST alone corrects the five actual vector competencies from J9 to the independently evidenced J10 entry-phase corridor. Three ordinary atoms remain J9 behind a structural proxy. The old vector cluster78 and operation-cluster1bc focus aliases become absent; valid atomic references remain valid. Existing stored focus references are retained and require explicit re-selection; a valid already-active goal may finish, no fallback widening or mastery/session/learner writes.

CrossStage places the unchanged task at each separately reviewed later corridor. The canonical reusable J9 task title remains exact; enclosing reviewed corridor structures express the actual acquisition stage, rather than asserting that the historical task title is an official current-year requirement.
Task scoring, 13 points, passing12, operation caps, full task, solution, five requires and five coveredGoalIds remain unchanged.
No task profile, new assessment, canonical requirement edge, semantic-kind or source-coverage change.

The existing compiler actually yields16 jurisdictions for8539 from its unchanged five requirements. Only that already-declared runtime cache is synchronized; all other goal fields, source facts, task/rubric/R/coverage and all other existing cache discrepancies are retained. Current whole-goal hash changes solely due to this metadata; exact content equivalence excludes only the declared applicability field. No Native or activation PASS is inferred.
